Speed Converter

m/s, km/h, mph, ft/s and knots.

Type in any field — the other four update instantly. Negative values are fine for headwinds or reverse motion.

📖 How to use

  1. Type a speed into any one of the five fields.
  2. The other four units update instantly as you type.
  3. Clear the field to reset all five values.
  4. Negative speeds are allowed for direction (e.g. headwind).

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I convert km/h to m/s?

Divide km/h by 3.6 to get m/s, or multiply m/s by 3.6 to get km/h.

What are the exact definitions of mph and knots?

1 mph = 0.44704 m/s exactly, and 1 knot = 0.514444 m/s exactly.

Can I type in any field?

Yes — type into any of the five fields and the other four update instantly.
